ART.name: Artifact and recovery manifests
ART.obligations: Hash, byte size, media type, storage generation, visibility, runtime/protocol identity, checkpoint completed prefix, deletion tombstones, bounded safe deserialization and complete export.

EXEC.name: Build, worker, lease and broker protocol
EXEC.obligations: Approved image digest, launch ID, lease epoch, attempt identity, resource deadline, cancellation, network scope, quarantined builds and networkless predictors. No fallback from required sandbox.

WEB.name: World catalog, committed events and replay
WEB.obligations: Immutable world versions/author projection, per-run sequence, typed payload, Last-Event-ID, cursor-expired snapshot/archive resync, bounded replay chunks and post-run truth authorization.

PROVIDER.name: Provider connection and durable call protocol
PROVIDER.obligations: Connection secret reference, provider/model/version, logical call/attempt state, token reservation, timeout ambiguity, request/response hash, billed/estimated/unknown usage, replay without network.

PRED.name: Executable predictor invocation
PRED.obligations: Public input only, protocol/image identity, timestamps/order/shape, finite outputs/declared intervals, CPU/wall/output caps and invalid-output failure classification.

OPS.name: Deployment, telemetry and recovery policy
OPS.obligations: Versioned IaC/config, keyless CI, isolated identities, bounded pools/metrics, exact evidence manifests, RPO/RTO/SLO targets and private records. Priced configuration needs SP-02.c; collection/rollout requires separate named gates.

GOV.obligations: Named decision/gate owner, exact source/config/test identity, unresolved blockers, privacy-safe evidence links, scope/estimate change record and explicit external approvals.
